subject: general
question: A, B and C individually can complete a work in 12, 10 and 15 days, respectively. All three work together and after 3 days, B and C leave the work. The remaining work will be completed by A in:
solution:
Given:

A, B and C individually can complete a work in 12, 10 and 15 days respectively

All three work together and after 3 days, B and C leave the work.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency × Total Time

Calculation:

LCM (12, 10, 15) = 60

Let the total work be 60 units (∵ LCM of 12, 10, 15 = 60)

Efficiency of A = 60/12 = 5 units/day

Efficiency of B = 60/10 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of C = 60/15 = 4 units/day

Work done in 3 days by A, B, C = 3 × (5 + 6 + 4) = 45 units

Time required by A to complete the remaining work

⇒ (60 - 45)/5 = 3 days

**∴ The remaining work will be completed by A in 3 days.**
